rect.style: stroke-width: 2.33; stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-linejoin: miter; fill: #EEEEEE; fill-opacity: 0.50;

polygon.style: stroke-width: 2.33; stroke: #333333; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-linejoin: miter; fill: #FFFFFF;

line.style: stroke-width: 4.66; stroke: #333333; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-linejoin: miter;
